entries.d835c384889ec28b: Gross profit, revenue less cost of sales, was ¥1,328,153 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (revenue for the same year was ¥13,995,222 million). Because a trading company's revenue includes the price of purchased products as is, the size of revenue and the size of profit need to be viewed as separate things. After deducting expenses from this and adding items such as equity-method investment profit of ¥447,442 million, which is the profit and loss of investees, profit for the year (attributable to owners of the parent) was ¥833,971 million. Profit for the year by segment is largest for Metal Resources, which does not match the order of revenue.
